modules.moduleTitle: 1. Primary Membranous Nephropathy, Podocyte Autoantigens & Nephrotic Hypercoagulability
modules.studyGuide: 本模組深入傳授 Primary Membranous Nephropathy 之分子靶抗原 (PLA2R1, THSD7A)、Immunologic vs Clinical Remission 之時序偶聯、Brenner Podocyte Subepithelial Deposits 病理特徵、以及 Nephrotic Syndrome 誘發之 Hypercoagulable State 與 RVT/VTE 臨床處置。

sections.heading: Primary Membranous Nephropathy Podocyte Autoantigens & Hypercoagulability Mechanics

diagrams.caption: Brenner 11e Fig. 31.17: Pathological spectrum of Membranous Nephropathy showing GBM spike formation.
Brenner 11e Fig. 31.18: Electron microscopy showing subepithelial electron-dense deposits in Membranous Nephropathy.
Figure 1.1: Pathophysiology of Podocyte Autoantigen Deposition and Nephrotic Hypercoagulable Cascade.

sections.content:
依據 Brenner 11e Ch 31 與 KDIGO 2021 Glomerular Diseases Guidelines 權威章節剖析：
Primary Membranous Nephropathy 為由 Autoantibodies 介導之 Podocyte 病變。自體抗體結合 Podocyte 膜表面表達之固有抗原，引發 Subepithelial immune complex formation 與 Complement C5b-9 MAC 活化。
1. **Autoantigen Spectrum & Prevalence**: PLA2R1 (M-type Phospholipase A2 Receptor 1) 為最主要標的 Autoantigen，佔成人 Primary Membranous Nephropathy 的 70–80%；THSD7A 則佔 1–5%，且與隱匿性 Malignancy 具高度相關。若 Serum Anti-PLA2R 呈陽性且呈典型 Nephrotic Syndrome 且 eGFR 正常，KDIGO 指引允許豁免 Kidney Biopsy。
2. **Immunologic vs Clinical Remission Dynamics**: Serum Anti-PLA2R 轉陰 (Immunologic Remission) 顯著領先 (precedes) Proteinuria 改善 (Clinical Remission) 數週至數月。若抗體已清除，應避免過度追加 Immunosuppression。
3. **Nephrotic Hypercoagulability & VTE Risk**: Serum Albumin 降至 < 2.0–2.5 g/dL 時，尿中流失 Antithrombin III 與 Protein S 伴隨 Hepatic synthesis of Fibrinogen 增加，強烈誘發 Hypercoagulable state，以 Renal Vein Thrombosis (RVT) 與 Pulmonary Embolism 為典型處置標的。

| Autoantigen / Parameter | Primary Membranous Nephropathy | Secondary / Malignancy-Associated MN |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dominant Autoantigen** | PLA2R1 (70–80%) & THSD7A (1–5%) | Tumor antigens, Exogenous antigens |
| **IgG Subclass Deposition** | Dominant IgG4 | Dominant IgG1 & IgG2 |
| **Electron Microscopy** | Subepithelial deposits & GBM spikes | Subepithelial + Subendothelial / Mesangial deposits |
| **Biopsy Exemption** | Allowed if Anti-PLA2R positive & eGFR normal | Biopsy required for underlying cause |

### Pathophysiological Decision Trees
- **Membranous Autoimmune Cascade**: Anti-PLA2R IgG4 ➔ Subepithelial Immune Complexes ➔ Complement C5b-9 MAC Assembly ➔ Podocyte Effacement ➔ Massive Proteinuria & Hypoalbuminemia ➔ AT-III Loss & RVT Risk.

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
- **Remission Timeline Trap**: Immunologic remission (Anti-PLA2R 轉陰) 比 Clinical remission (Proteinuria 消退) 早數個月發生；切勿因 Proteinuria 尚未完全消失而誤判治療失敗追加高劑量免疫抑制劑。
- **THSD7A Malignancy Trap**: THSD7A-associated MN 具顯著 Female predominance 且高風險伴隨 Solid Tumors，目前 KDIGO 指引不允許單憑 Anti-THSD7A 陽性豁免 Kidney Biopsy。

modules.moduleTitle: 2. Granulomatous Calcitriol Metabolism & Ectopic Parathyroid Endocrine Dynamics
modules.studyGuide: 本模組解析 Granulomatous Diseases (Tuberculosis, Sarcoidosis) 引起之 Extra-renal Calcitriol 過度製造、Ectopic Parathyroid Adenoma 之 Mediastinal 診斷排查、與 Sestamibi Scan 偽陽性陷阱。

Brenner 11e Fig. 18.1: Diagnostic evaluation algorithm for Hypercalcemia and intact PTH level.

sections.heading: Granulomatous Calcitriol Metabolism & Ectopic Parathyroid Endocrine Dynamics

diagrams.caption: Brenner 11e Fig. 7.4: Renal and extra-renal Vitamin D 1-alpha-hydroxylation pathways.
Brenner 11e Fig. 18.1: Diagnostic evaluation algorithm for Hypercalcemia and intact PTH level.
Figure 2.1: Granulomatous Macrophage 1-Alpha-Hydroxylase Activation vs Parathyroid Adenoma Dynamics.

sections.content:
依據 Brenner 11e Ch 7 & Ch 18 權威解剖生理學：
Calcium 與 Phosphate 代謝受到 Parathyroid Hormone (PTH)、Calcitriol (1,25(OH)2D3) 與 FGF23 之精密調控。
1. **Granulomatous Extra-Renal Calcitriol Overproduction**: 於 Tuberculosis 與 Sarcoidosis 等 Granulomatous Diseases 中，Activated Macrophages 異常表達 1-alpha-hydroxylase。該酵素缺乏負回饋調控機制，不受 PTH、FGF23 或 Hypercalcemia 抑制，自主將 25(OH)D 轉換為 Calcitriol，導致 Intestinal calcium absorption 大幅增加並誘發 Hypercalcemia 與 Suppressed PTH。
2. **Ectopic Parathyroid Embryogenesis & Localization**: Inferior Parathyroid Glands 與 Thymus 同由 Third Pharyngeal Pouch 發育移行。若移行受阻，可能形成位在 Anterior Mediastinum 的 Ectopic Parathyroid Adenoma，表現為 PTH-dependent Hypercalcemia。
3. **Sestamibi Imaging False Positivity**: Technetium-99m Sestamibi Scan 在偵測 Parathyroid Adenoma 時，會因為 Tuberculosis 引起的 Mediastinal Lymphadenopathy 與 Calcified Nodes 產生擬似顯影，造成 Sestamibi False Positive。

| Clinical Parameter | Primary Hyperparathyroidism (PHP) | Granulomatous Hypercalcemia (TB / Sarcoidosis) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Serum Calcium** | Elevated | Elevated |
| **Serum Intact PTH** | Inappropriately Normal or High | Markedly Suppressed |
| **1,25(OH)2D Calcitriol** | Elevated (PTH-driven) | Markedly Elevated (Macrophage-driven) |
| **1-alpha-hydroxylase Source** | Renal Proximal Tubule (PTH responsive) | Extra-renal Granulomatous Macrophages (Autonomous) |

### Pathophysiological Decision Trees
- **Granulomatous Hypercalcemia Cascade**: Active TB Granuloma ➔ Macrophage 1-alpha-hydroxylase Overexpression ➔ Uncontrolled 25(OH)D Conversion to Calcitriol ➔ Increased Intestinal Calcium Absorption ➔ Hypercalcemia ➔ Feedback Suppression of Parathyroid Glands (Low PTH).

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
- **Sestamibi Imaging Trap**: Mediastinal Technetium-99m Sestamibi Uptake 陽性不等於 Ectopic Parathyroid Adenoma；必須先檢視 Serum Intact PTH。若 PTH 受抑制，應排查 Tuberculosis / Sarcoidosis 引起的 Mediastinal Lymphadenopathy 偽陽性。

modules.moduleTitle: 3. Diabetic Microvascular Pathology & Infection-Related Glomerulonephritis Spectrum
modules.studyGuide: 本模組對比 Diabetic Glomerulosclerosis (Kimmelstiel-Wilson Nodules, Non-specific Linear IgG Adsorption) 與 Infection-Related Glomerulonephritis (Staphylococcus PIGN, IgA Dominance, Subepithelial Humps)。

Brenner 11e Fig. 31.12: Post-infectious Glomerulonephritis showing subepithelial deposits (humps).

sections.heading: Diabetic Glomerulosclerosis & Post-Staphylococcal Glomerulonephritis Pathology

diagrams.caption: Brenner 11e Fig. 39.4: Nodular glomerulosclerosis (Kimmelstiel-Wilson lesions) in Diabetic Nephropathy.
Brenner 11e Fig. 31.12: Post-infectious Glomerulonephritis showing subepithelial deposits (humps).
Figure 3.1: Diabetic Nodular Glomerulosclerosis vs Staphylococcus-Associated IgA-Dominant PIGN.

sections.content:
依據 Brenner 11e Ch 31 & Ch 39 權威腎臟病理學：
1. **Diabetic Nephropathy Histopathology**: 慢性高血糖誘發 AGEs (Advanced Glycation End-products) 累積，引致 Diffuse GBM Thickening, Mesangial Expansion, Arteriolar Hyalinosis 以及特徵性 Kimmelstiel-Wilson Nodules。於 Immunofluorescence (IF) 觀察下，增厚之 GBM 常出現 Non-specific Linear IgG & Albumin Staining (因 Plasma Protein Passive Adsorption)，絕非 Anti-GBM Disease 的 Pathogenic Autoantibodies。
2. **Staphylococcus-Associated PIGN**: 於高齡、Diabetes Mellitus 或 MRSA Infection 患者中，進行中之 Staphylococcal Infection 可誘發 IgA-Dominant 或 IgA/C3 Co-dominant Immune Complex Deposition。切片呈 Endocapillary Proliferation 伴隨 Subepithelial Humps，且 Serum C3 水平可呈現正常或低下。

| Pathological Feature | Diabetic Glomerulosclerosis | Staphylococcus-Associated PIGN | Anti-GBM Disease |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Light Microscopy** | Kimmelstiel-Wilson nodules & GBM thickening | Endocapillary proliferation & Exudative neutrophils | Crescentic Glomerulonephritis |
| **Immunofluorescence** | Non-specific linear IgG & Albumin adsorption | IgA-dominant / C3 immune deposits | Pathogenic linear IgG along GBM |
| **Electron Microscopy** | Diffuse GBM thickening & Mesangial matrix expansion | Large Subepithelial Humps | Absence of humps, GBM rupture |

### Pathophysiological Decision Trees
- **Diabetic Microvascular Cascade**: Chronic Hyperglycemia ➔ Non-enzymatic Glycation (AGEs) ➔ GBM Thickening & Permeability Alteration ➔ Passive Linear IgG Adsorption ➔ Kimmelstiel-Wilson Nodular Expansion.

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
- **Linear IgG Immunofluorescence Trap**: Diabetic Nephropathy 切片出現 Linear IgG 染色為非特異性 Protein Adsorption；切勿誤診為 Anti-GBM Disease (Goodpasture Syndrome) 並錯誤開立 Plasma Exchange。

modules.moduleTitle: 4. Peritoneal Transport Mechanics, ARNI Hemodynamics & Proximal Tubular Biomarkers
modules.studyGuide: 本模組解析 Peritoneal Dialysis Transporter Status (PET D/P Creatinine, Ultrafiltration Failure, Icodextrin Indication)、ARNI (Sacubitril/Valsartan) 雙重 Renal Hemodynamic 效應、與 Tubular AKI Damage Biomarkers (KIM-1, IL-18)。

diagrams.caption: Brenner 11e Fig. 64.2: Peritoneal Equilibration Test (PET) D/P Creatinine curves and transport categories.
Brenner 11e Fig. 28.1: Pathophysiological phases of Acute Kidney Injury and proximal tubular structural injury.

sections.heading: Peritoneal Transport Mechanics, ARNI Hemodynamics & Tubular Damage Biomarkers

diagrams.caption: Brenner 11e Fig. 64.2: Peritoneal Equilibration Test (PET) D/P Creatinine curves and transport categories.
Brenner 11e Fig. 28.1: Pathophysiological phases of Acute Kidney Injury and proximal tubular structural injury.
Figure 4.1: Peritoneal High Transporter Ultrafiltration Mechanics vs ARNI Hemodynamic Efferent/Afferent Arteriole Control.

sections.content:
依據 Brenner 11e Ch 28 & Ch 64 權威透析與藥理學：
1. **Peritoneal Transport Mechanics & High Transporter State**: 於 Peritoneal Dialysis 中，PET (Peritoneal Equilibration Test) 4-hour D/P Creatinine > 0.81 定義為 High Transporter。腹膜微血管密度高導致 Solute clearance 快，但 Dialysate Glucose 快速吸收使 Osmotic Gradient 迅速消失，引致 Long Dwell Ultrafiltration Failure。處置應轉為 Short Dwell APD 或使用 Colloid Osmotic Agent (Icodextrin)。
2. **ARNI Dual Hemodynamic Dip Mechanism**: Sacubitril (Neprilysin Inhibitor 增加 ANP/BNP) 誘導 Afferent Arteriole Dilation，Valsartan (ARB) 誘導 Efferent Arteriole Dilation。雙重作用降低 Intraglomerular Hydrostatic Pressure，導致初期可逆性 Hemodynamic eGFR Dip (< 30%)，屬於功能性保護性變化。
3. **Proximal Tubular Structural Damage Biomarkers**: 若為 Ischemic 或 Nephrotoxic AKI 造成之真實器官結構性損傷，Proximal Tubular Epithelial Cells 會脫落並高量釋放 KIM-1 (Kidney Injury Molecule-1) 與 IL-18，可用以區分 Hemodynamic Pseudo-AKI 與 Real Tubular Injury。

| Parameter / Entity | High Peritoneal Transporter | Low Peritoneal Transporter |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PET D/P Creatinine at 4 Hours** | High (> 0.81) | Low (< 0.50) |
| **Glucose Osmotic Gradient Dissipation** | Rapid absorption & rapid loss | Prolonged maintenance |
| **Ultrafiltration Capacity** | Impaired during long dwells | Well preserved during long dwells |
| **Optimal Dialysis Prescription** | Short Dwell APD or Icodextrin | Standard CAPD with long dwells |

### Pathophysiological Decision Trees
- **ARNI Dual Arteriole Hemodynamic Cascade**: Sacubitril (Afferent Vasodilation) + Valsartan (Efferent Vasodilation) ➔ Lower Intraglomerular Hydrostatic Pressure ➔ Initial Reversible Hemodynamic eGFR Dip ➔ Long-Term Nephron Preservation.

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
- **ARNI Initial eGFR Dip Trap**: 起始 ARNI 後 eGFR 出現 < 30% 之初期下降為功能性 Hemodynamic Response；切勿誤判為 Structural AKI 而盲目停藥。
- **High Transporter Long Dwell Trap**: High Transporter 患者若使用長 dwell time 葡萄糖透析液，Glucose 吸收後會造成 Fluid Reabsorption & Ultrafiltration Failure；必須改用 Icodextrin 或短 dwell time 處方。
